lesson: Two errors in this batch were the same error: a count written by hand drifting from the rows it summarised, and a reproducibility gap asserted from memory ('model identity not pinned') that the artifacts contradicted — qwen2.5:7b at threshold 0.82 was in every router artifact's settings block. Both were caught by reading the artifact rather than by rereading the prose. The rule this produces: any number stated in a document must be either extracted by a script from an artifact or checked against one before the document is rendered. Prose is not a store of record.
